title: Winsell Energy Saving Group Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Materials Manufacturer
content:
Winsell Energy Saving Group Co., Ltd. is a large Chinese insulation and energy-saving materials group with official coverage across industrial insulation, building-envelope materials, marine insulation, and rail noise-reduction systems. Public industry sources report that the group has expanded into aerogel materials through dedicated project investment and related high-performance insulation operations.

Company Overview

The official corporate website presents Winsell as a high-end insulation system service provider serving major industrial and building sectors. In addition to the insulation businesses confirmed on the official site, public aerogel-industry source material reports dedicated aerogel production expansion associated with the group’s operations.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: Mainland China with broad industrial and project-service coverage.
  • Focus Areas: Industrial thermal insulation, building-envelope insulation, marine insulation, rail transportation insulation and noise reduction, and related high-performance thermal materials.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Industrial insulation systems
  • Building-envelope energy-saving materials
  • Marine insulation materials
  • Rail vehicle insulation and noise-reduction materials
  • Public Aerogel Project Reference: Industry roundup sources report a subsidiary aerogel materials project with annual capacity around 50,000 m³, but this figure is not clearly stated on the reviewed official corporate pages.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Presence: China-based group operations with nationwide service and manufacturing footprint described on the official site.
  • International Certifications: Specific aerogel-related international certification details are not clearly listed on the reviewed official pages.
  • Official Website: https://www.wincellchina.com/

FAQ

Why is Winsell included in the aerogel directory?

The official corporate site confirms Winsell’s large-scale insulation-material business, while public aerogel-industry sources report dedicated aerogel expansion and project capacity associated with the group.

Which sectors does Winsell serve?

The official site highlights industrial insulation, building-envelope materials, marine insulation, and rail insulation and noise-reduction systems.

Is the aerogel capacity figure confirmed on the official site?

No. The reviewed official site confirms the broader insulation business, but the specific aerogel capacity figure comes from public industry-source reporting rather than the official corporate pages reviewed here.
